meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

copy.tagline: 为聊天助手装上跨会话记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给 Grok 机器人增加持久记忆能力。
copy.tagline_en: Give your chat assistant persistent memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add lasting memory to your Grok bot.

howto.what: 装好后,Grok Bot 会跑一个本地 worker 加观察者,为每个 agent 监听会话转录,并在真实任务开始时通过 MCP 提供 session_start_context 上下文。
howto.when: 当你要在 Grok Bot 上安装 claude-mem 时使用:默认本地 worker 加 CMEM Pro 观察者,也可选 host-login 观察者或远程 cmem.ai。不需要 Cursor。

say.text: 帮我在 Grok Bot 上装 claude-mem,走默认路径
换成 host 登录方式做观察者(--provider host)

howto.what_en: After install, Grok Bot runs a local worker plus observer (CMEM Pro by default), watches each agent's transcript, and serves session_start_context over MCP at the start of a real task.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: default local worker plus CMEM Pro observer, optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Grok Bot with the default path
Use the host-login observer instead (--provider host)
Install the remote version pointing at https://cmem.ai
